description:
Imagine Freeware Image & Animation Viewer for Windows

Imagine is a free, lightweight image and animation viewer for Windows, known for its minimal resource usage, extensive format support, and fast performance even on legacy hardware. It combines essential viewing tools with batch processing capabilities in a compact package. It supports numerous image and animation formats, digital camera RAW formats, and archive formats, and includes image manipulation, batch conversion, slide show, capture screen, and multilingual support.
- Added: Preset support in batch conversion
 - Added: Translatable file type option value
 - Added: Preview in batch conversion dialog
 - Fixed: Crash during batch rename in 64-bit version
 - Fixed: Error when deleting the last file in the list in the viewer window
 - Fixed: Delay when opening PNG files
 - Fixed: Error in editing comment metadata consisting of non-ASCII characters
